भोः

BHOḤ . A term used for greeting elders. When saluting an elderly person, the term “Bhoḥ” is used as a suffix to his name.

For example:“Somaśarmā nāma aham asmi bhoḥ”
bhoḥ śabdaṁ kīrtayedante
Svasya nāmnābhivādane ।
Nāmnāṁ svarūpa bhāvo hi
bhobhāvo ṛṣibḥiḥ smṛtaḥ ।।
(manusmṛti, Chapter 2, verse 124)
